elements.text: Destroy the Depot Foreman in the processing hall and recover the Foreman Control Core from its wreck.

elements.name: radio-text
elements.text: Listen. Something big just woke in the depot's processing hall: a foreman unit, still running its old shift. It's slow, but it hits hard and shrugs off a stagger. When its optics flare red, step back. Put it down and bring me its control core.
